model.description: The model the agent answers a prompt with, as its own configuration names it. It is the name the agent asks for, often an alias rather than the dated snapshot that serves a call. It is bounded because a receiver displays it. Absent from an agent that answers no prompts.

protocols.description: Protocol namespaces the agent supports, e.g. io.choria.fisk-ai.v1.

telemetry.description: The agent exports traces of what it does.

telemetry_content.description: Those traces carry the conversation itself, not only its structure and timing, so a prompt sent here reaches the operator's collector.
